submission.summary:
Reviewed PR #2 (`codex/content-document-contracts` → `main`, head `ae99a13`, 36 files / +3522 / −2) across all five evidence stages.

**Deterministic evidence:** `summary.json` records overall `failure` — 11 of 12 gates pass; `receipt_history` exits 2 ("Receipt River head does not preserve the base bytes as a prefix") at the exact PR head under the PR's own workflow command (`verify-receipts --base 4927ab7 --at ae99a13`). This is change-associated, not environment noise.

**Confirmed blocking findings:**

1. **(high, state-transition, conf 0.90) — `receipt_history` gate is red at head.** The receipts diff hunk (`@@ -154,4 +154,19 @@`, zero deletions) inserts six added receipts before the base's final record (`dev-origin-map`, old 157 = head 163), so base is no longer a byte prefix of head by construction (`scripts/evidence.clj:1020-1022` throws on exactly this). The PR body discloses the blocker but the gate is unwaived; merge admission stays red until the append ordering reconciles to a true prefix.

2. **(high, contract, conf 0.93) — the PR's own eleven new receipts violate `receipt-envelope?`.** Added receipts at head lines 157–162 and 164–168 carry string `:manifest` and `:refs`; the law (`src/foresight/evidence.cljc:227-229`) requires vectors, and `require-valid-receipt-records!` runs on every post-base record in both `verify-receipts!` and `promotion-ready-at!` — the base-prefix compatibility clause never covers them. Grep confirms base has exactly the eleven historical string-envelope receipts (94–100, 134–137), so the head total is **twenty-two**, not eleven as claimed in the PR body and in the added receipts 171/172. Fixing the prefix alone will surface this second failure; the new receipts (169–172 use vectors) must be rewritten to the valid vector shape and the count claims corrected.

**Non-blocking notes / caveats:**
- Rejected candidate: "admission does not check derivedness" (`document.cljc:107`) — explicitly out of documented scope (docstring + README state admission "cannot establish that the representation follows from its input"); intended behavior, not a defect. The source-identity comparison fix and its regression tests audited clean; all `admit-document` branches are covered.
- Workflow pin bump (`e8eea02`→`b18764d`, `python3 -B`) is sound.
- Environment limits: katamorph submodule and `.review-context/metadata` absent from this checkout, so local alpha/test execution was not possible; `pr.diff` was truncated at 3746 lines (hunks for all named risk zones were read in full). These are runner caveats, not defects.

**Verdict:** REQUEST_CHANGES — two confirmed blocking findings, both above the publication threshold; both are in the receipts ledger this PR adds and both must be repaired (prefix-safe append order + vector `:manifest`/`:refs` in the eleven new receipts, with the "eleven invalid" claim corrected) before merge admission can pass.

comments.body: Impact: deterministic summary.json records result "failure" with receipt_history exit 2 at head ae99a13. Evidence: six added receipts (head 157-162) land before context record dev-origin-map; scripts/evidence.clj appended-receipt-records! throws when base bytes are not a prefix of head bytes. Corrective direction: restore base as exact byte prefix and re-run verify-receipts.

Impact: receipt-envelope? (src/foresight/evidence.cljc lines 227-229) requires (vector? (:manifest receipt)) and (vector? (:refs receipt)); scripts/evidence.clj require-valid-receipt-records! (lines 226-234) throws "Immutable ledger contains invalid receipt envelopes" over every record in the suffix appended after base, and both verify-receipts! (line 1051) and promotion-ready-at! (lines 262-264) apply it to appended records. Evidence: the added receipt on this line (head 164) carries :manifest ".eta-mu/receipts.edn,..." and :refs "fork-main:4927ab7...;..." as strings; the same string/string shape appears on added lines 157-162 and 165-168 (eleven added receipts total), while later added receipts at head 169-172 correctly use vectors. This also falsifies the count stated in the PR body and in the added receipts at head 171/172 ("eleven historical/immutable invalid string-manifest/ref receipts remain"): the eleven pre-existing invalid envelopes (base lines 94-100, 134-137) are joined by these eleven newly appended ones, so head holds twenty-two invalid envelopes, and the new eleven are neither historical nor grandfathered (only bytes at the base prefix receive historical compatibility). Smallest corrective direction: rewrite :manifest/:refs of the eleven added receipts to vectors before merge (they are branch-local, not yet immutable base history), and correct the disclosed invalid-count claims.
